I decided to double up on reel meals since I’m behind with editing… Loaded Chicken Twice Baked Potato!!! Nuff said. I wish y’all could taste through the screen omg. I tore this meal DOWN ——————————————— RECIPEEEE! If y'all been following me y'all know I do not measure but i'll try my best.  Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. You're basically making a baked potato. Take your potatoes (russet) and wash them. Then cover with oil (I used vegetable oil) and individually wrap each potato tightly in aluminum foil. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

BBQ Cheeseburger sliders are an easy weeknight dinner the whole family will love!  INGREDIENTS 12 count King’s Hawaiian Rolls 1 lb ground beef 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika   1 tbsp minced garlic  2 tbsp BBQ sauce  Pepper jack cheese slices Shredded colby jack cheese   Crispy fried onions  6 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled  2 tbsp melted butter  Sesame seeds  INSTRUCTIONS Preheat your oven to 350 degrees F.  Cook 1 lb of ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika. Once the ground beef is browned, drain any extra grease from the skillet. Add the minced garlic and BBQ sauce. Stir well.  Slice Hawaiian Rolls in half and put the bottom of the rolls in a greased baking dish or on a sheet pan.  Add a layer of pepper jack cheese. Add the ground beef on top of the cheese. Top the ground beef with shredded colby jack cheese, some crumbled bacon, and crispy fried onions. Top with a little bit more BBQ sauce if desired! Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 6. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm. #bread #garlicbread #breadtok #baking #homemadebread

videos.caption: This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Chicken broccoli cheddar soup 🧀🥦🍂 felt a breeze outside so it’s finally soup season! Full recipe below  Ingredients - 2 tablespoons olive oil - 1 medium onion diced - 5 garlic cloves, minced - 1 shallot, minced  - 3 carrots, shredded - 4 slices bacon, diced - 4oz diced pancetta  - 2 cups chicken broth  - 1 cup whole milk - 1 cup heavy cream - 2 chicken breast, butterflied & shredded  - 4 cups broccoli florets, chopped - 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tsp dried thyme - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder - 1 packet of sazon - Salt and pepper to taste - 3 tbsp all-purpose flour - 2 tbsp butter Instructions  - In a large pan on medium high heat add olive oil and seasoned chicken breast. Cook for 4 minutes on each side. Pour in chicken stock, cover and cook until done and tender enough to shred. Shred chicken and sit aside - Add bacon and pancetta to large pot, cook until done remove from the pot. In the remaining grease add diced onion and cook until it becomes translucent, about 3-4 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds until fragrant. - Add butter, flour, and mix until well combined. Pour in chicken broth, stir until combined. Add the carrots, and broccoli. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10-15 minutes  - Pour in milk, heavy cream, same seasonings from the chicken and mix until well combined. Add shredded chicken, cheddar cheese, bacon, and pancetta . Stir until well combined taste and adjust seasoning as needed with more salt and pepper. • • #broccolicheddarsoup #dinnerideas #chickensoup #soupseason #falldinner #fyp #recipes

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato — just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 ⸻ 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g garlic butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping ⸻ Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. ⸻ 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. ⸻ 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan ⸻ 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #bakedpotato #lasagna

Hot honey chicken sliders 🍔✨🍯 Ingredients  Chicken  - 1lb chicken breast, cut in half to create smaller pieces  - 1 1/3 cups buttermilk  - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1/4 cup pickle juice  - 1 1/2 cup all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 2 tsp cayenne powder (use less if desired) - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard powder  - 1 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) - Oil for frying  - Slider buns Hot honey sauce - 2 tbsp unsalted butter  - 1/3 cup hot sauce  - 1/2 cup honey - 1/2 tsp brown sugar  - 1/8 tsp salt  Instructions: - In a bowl, combine chicken pieces, buttermilk, seasonings, pickle juice and hot sauce. Let sit for 3 hours (or overnight in the fridge for best results). - In another bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. - Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). - Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. Rest the floured chicken for 10 minutes before frying  - Fry in batches 4–6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, and hot sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with hot honey sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. Chocolate Strawberry Banana Bread 🍓🍌✨ Ingredients: 	•	3 overripe bananas, mashed (330 g) 	•	4 tbsp unsalted butter, melted (56 g) 	•	¼ cup Greek yogurt or sour cream (60 g) 	•	½ cup brown sugar, packed (100 g) 	•	¼ cup granulated sugar (50 g) 	•	1 large egg (≈50 g) 	•	1 tsp vanilla extract (5 g) 	•	1¼ cups all-purpose flour (150 g) 	•	⅓ cup cocoa powder (≈30 g) 	•	1 tsp baking soda (5 g) 	•	1 tsp cinnamon (≈2.5 g) 	•	Dash of salt (≈0.5 g) 	•	½ cup chocolate chips, plus more for topping (85 g) 	•	⅓ cup chopped strawberries (≈50 g), plus extra for topping @Nestle Toll House  Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease or line a loaf pan with parchment paper.In a medium bowl, mash the bananas until smooth. Add the melted butter and Greek yogurt (or sour cream) and mix until combined. Stir in the egg and vanilla extract. Add the brown sugar and granulated sugar; mix well until smooth. Gently fold in the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt until just combined — do not overmix. Fold in the chocolate chips and chopped strawberries. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan. Sprinkle extra chocolate chips and chopped strawberries on top. Bake for 35–40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out mostly clean (a few moist crumbs are okay). Let cool in the pan for 10–15 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. #bananabread #Recipe #chocolatestrawberries #valentine #bakingrecipe

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Лучший в мире торт — шоколадный! 🍫💥 Серьёзно, после этого рецепта все остальные просто отдыхают 😏 Шоколадный рай своими руками  🍰 Ингредиенты Бисквит: 🥚 Яйца — 4 шт 🍬 Сахар — 100 г 🌾 Мука — 80 г 🍫 Какао — 20 г ✨ Разрыхлитель — 5 г 🧈 Сливочное масло — 25 г Крем: 🍼 Сгущённое молоко — 200 г 🥛 Молоко — 200 г 🥚 Яйцо — 1 шт 🍫 Какао — 20 г 🍫 Шоколад — 50 г 🌽 Крахмал кукурузный — 20 г 🧈 Масло сливочное — 110 г Пропитка: 💧 Вода — 140 г 🍫 Какао — 10 г 🍬 Сахар — 15 г 🍓 Малиновый джем — по вкусу Глазурь: 🍫 Шоколад (72%) — 80 г 🥛 Сливки (33%) — 80 г 👩🏻‍🍳 Приготовление Бисквит: 1️⃣ Раздели яйца на белки и желтки. Белки взбей до плотных пиков. 2️⃣ К желткам добавь сахар и взбей до светлой пышной массы. 3️⃣ Соедини обе части, аккуратно перемешай. 4️⃣ Просей муку, какао и разрыхлитель — вмешай лопаткой. 5️⃣ Добавь растопленное масло, перемешай и выпекай при 180 °C ~35 мин. 6️⃣ Остуди, разрежь на 3–4 коржа. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

FLATBREAD WITH BUTTER CHICKEN #food #recipe #chicken #butterchicken #flatbread CHICKEN MIXTURE 25 g unsalted butter 20 ml sunflower oil 600 g chicken thighs, cut into cubes 5 g garam masala (1⅔ tsp) 2 g ground coriander (⅔ tsp) 2 g ground cumin (⅔ tsp) 3 g garlic powder (1 tsp) 4 g onion powder (1⅓ tsp) 2 g cayenne pepper (⅔ tsp) 30 g tomato paste 50 ml water 100 ml heavy cream 15 g honey 1 chicken stock cube 100 g grated cheese (Gouda) DOUGH 350 g all-purpose flour 50 g herb cream cheese 4 g salt (⅔ tsp) 6 g baking powder 170 ml water EXTRA cheese slices Heat the butter and sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper. Fry for 5–6 minutes. Add the tomato paste, water, cream, and honey. Mix well and let simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Crumble the chicken stock cube over the pan. Add the grated cheese and stir until creamy. Remove from the heat and let the chicken mixture cool completely. Place the flour, baking powder, herb cream cheese, salt, and water in a large bowl. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth. Cover and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces of about 70 g each and shape into balls. Roll out a dough ball into a circle. Place a slice of cheese on one half and spread about 90 g of the chicken mixture on top. Lightly moisten the edges, fold the dough closed, and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the filled dough on a sheet of parchment paper. Heat a heavy-bottomed frying pan with a little oil. Cook the breads over medium-high heat until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Tips Don’t cut the chicken too small. Cubes of about 2 cm give a better bite. Let the mixture thicken well. The sauce should be creamy and firm, not runny like a curry. Let it cool completely. A warm filling makes the dough soft and hard to seal. Letting the dough rest is important. Those 10 minutes make it more elastic and easier to roll out. Use any cheese you like. You can also bake these breads in the oven. Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F) and bake for 15–20 minutes (brush with oil or butter). Add salt to taste. Preparation Time Chicken mixture preparation & cooling: 20 minutes Dough preparation & resting: 25 minutes Cooking: 10–15 minutes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Sweet chili garlic chicken tenders. Ingredients  1 lb chicken tenders For the wet batter: 1 1/2 cup butter milk 2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp soy sauce  1/4 cup hot sauce  Salt to taste 1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tbsp onion powder  1 tbsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp black pepper powder  For the dry batter: 2 cups all purpose flour 1/2 cup corn starch  2 tbsp baking powder  Salt to taste 1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tbsp onion powder  1 tbsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp black pepper powder  For the sweet chili garlic sauce  1/3 cup honey  2 tbsp ketchup  1 tbsp soy sauce sauce  1 tbsp fresh lemon juice  1/4 cup hot sauce  1 tbsp chili garlic sauce  3 cloves garlic, minced Salt to taste 2 tbsp butter, cold For the ranch dressing  1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/4 cup sour cream 2 tbsp buttermilk 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp dried parsley 1/4 tsp dried dill 1/4 tsp black pepper 1 tsp lemon juice Salt to taste Method: Marinate chicken with buttermilk, lemon juice, soy sauce, hot sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Mix well, cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or 2–4 hours for the best flavor and tenderness. In a bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Remove chicken from the buttermilk mixture and coat well in seasoned flour, pressing the flour onto the chicken. Dip back into the reserved buttermilk marinade, then coat again in flour, pressing and squeezing the flour onto the chicken for a thick, craggy coating. Let rest for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F and fry in batches for 4–6 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and the chicken reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to keep crispy. For the sauce, add honey, ketchup, soy sauce, lemon juice, hot sauce, chili garlic sauce, garlic, and salt to a saucepan. Simmer over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened. Turn heat to low and whisk in the cold butter. Lightly brush the sweet chili garlic glaze over the chicken tenders. For the ranch, whisk everything together and refrigerate for 15–30 minutes. Serve with ranch and enjoy #recipe #chickentenders

Chicken alfredo tacos 🌮  For the chicken 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp oil for marinating + more for cooking For the Alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp all purpose flour  2 cloves fresh garlic, minced  1 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream Salt to taste  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 cup milk 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated  To assemble  15-16 mini tacos 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for lightly frying the tacos 1/4 cup parsley, freshly chopped for garnish  Method  Marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, and oil for 20–30 minutes. Cook until golden and set aside. In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the garlic. Whisk in the flour, then add the heavy cream and milk. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Simmer until slightly thickened, then stir in the Parmesan until smooth.  Add the cooked chicken to half of the sauce and toss to coat. Reserve half for later . Fill each tortilla with mozzarella, the chicken Alfredo mixture, and a little more mozzarella. Fold and pan-fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with extra Alfredo sauce for dipping. #recipe #tacos #alfredochicken

Easy High Protein Meal Prep Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍗🧀 Most Viral Recipe of 2025! 🔥 100+ million views combined across all social media platforms, this high protein honey bbq chicken mac & cheese recipe is the tastiest & easiest meal prep recipe to start your health journey in 2026 👨🏻‍🍳🫡 (Macros: Per Serving - Recipe Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Ingredients: 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Each of Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder 1 Tsp Olive Oil 25g Honey 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce) 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 80g Light Cream Cheese 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar Cheese) Instructions: 1. Start by seasoning your diced chicken breast with 1 tsp each of salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder then add 1 tsp of olive oil & mix well. 2. Cook the chicken on medium/high heat for 4 min each side or until cooked through, once the chicken is cooked take it off the heat & add 25g of honey with 85g of bbq sauce. 3. Mix well to combine until the chicken is coated in the sauce. 4. Start cooking 320g of pasta (uncooked weight) in boiling water according to package directions. 5. While the pasta is cooking to a pan on medium heat add 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk, 80g light cream cheese, 1.5 tsp chicken stock powder, 100g light grated cheddar cheese & continue stirring until the sauce is fully combined & smooth/creamy. 6. Add the cooked & drained pasta to the Mac & cheese sauce then mix until the pasta is fully coated. 7. Divide the Honey BBQ Chicken and Mac & Cheese into 4 equal servings for meal prep PRO TIP: Add a splash of milk before reheating your meal prep so the mac and cheese turns out creamy every time & mix well. #macandcheese #macncheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Cinnamon pumpkin crumble bread ✨🍂 I have so many fall recipes that I tested over the summer and can’t wait to share! Also layer the sugar mixture in the middle of the loaf, got too caught up and ended up adding it to the top. Ingredients  - 250g all-purpose flour (2 cups) - 110g dark brown sugar (1/2 cup) - 105g granulated sugar (1/2 cup) - 60ml buttermilk or milk (1/4 cup) - 113g unsalted butter, melted (1/2 cup, 1 stick) - 12oz pumpkin puree  - 6g baking powder (1 tsp) - 6g baking soda (1 tsp) - 2 eggs - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 2 tsp cinnamon  - 1 tsp pumpkin spice  - 1/2 tsp ground ginger  - 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg  - 1/2 tsp salt Crumble - 115g all-purpose flour (1/2 cup + 1 tbsp) - 55g granulated sugar (1/4 cup) - 40g brown sugar (3 tbsp) - 58g unsalted butter, melted (1/4 cup) - 1/2 tsp cinnamon  - 1/4 tsp all spice  - 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg  Cinnamon mixture - 55g sugar (1/4 cup) - 58g unsalted butter, melted (1/4 cup) - 1 tsp cinnamon  Icing - 50g powder sugar (1/3 cup + 2 tbsp) - 1/2 tsp pumpkin spice  - 1/2 tsp cinnamon - 1 tbsp milk  Instructions  - Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Grease and line a 1.5 pound loaf pan with parchment paper. Crumble  - In a small bowl, combine flour, brown sugar, granulated sugar, allspice, nutmeg and cinnamon. - Add melted butter and mix it into a crumbly mixture. - Place in the fridge while preparing the batter (this keeps it from melting too fast). Dry ingredients  - In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Set aside. Wet ingredients  - In a large bowl, whisk pumpkin puree, melted butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla, and buttermilk  until smooth.  - To wet ingredients qdd spices (cinnamon, nutmeg, pumpkin spice, and ginger.) Then add flour mixture to the wet mixture. - Gently fold dry ingredients into wet mixture until just combined. Do not overmix. - Pour half batter into prepared loaf pan. Add cinnamon butter mixture spread evenly and add the remaining batter.  - Evenly sprinkle the crumble topping over the batter. - Bake for 80-90 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean (a few moist crumbs are okay). - If the crumble starts to brown too quickly, tent loosely with foil halfway through. - Let bread cool in pan for 15 minutes, then lift out and place on a wire rack. - Once bread cool  warm add icing drizzle.  • • • #fallrecipes #baking #pumpkinseason #bakingrecipe #Recipe

Save this recipe and thank me later 😌 RECIPE ⬇️ * 1 lb 80/20 ground beef * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  * 2 tsp Worcestershire  * Minced garlic  * Salt & pepper to taste  * Optional add-ins: caramelized onions, bacon * Mild cheddar, large cubes * Shredded mozzarella  * 1 can biscuit dough (Pillsbury original flakey layers, red top) * 1 egg, whisked (for egg wash) * Parmesan  Garlic butter: * 3 tbs salted butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, finely minced * Dried or fresh parsley 1. We had many people in our comments who assumed we were just random people who bought a tiger cub and many people asking where they can get a tiger. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. When he is older and cleared to go outside you can see him in his enclosure if you visit the zoo. We hope that clears a few things up!

chicken alfredo garlic bread !! 🍗🧄 recipe: 1 large italian loaf  (i made my own bread for this, but you can use large Italian loaves from the store! i recommend using a thick, wide loaf so there’s plenty of surface area for all the ingredients ) garlic butter: ½ cup salted butter, softened 4–5 cloves garlic, finely minced 1 tbsp  parsley ½ tsp Italian seasoning ¼ tsp garlic powder mix the softened butter with the garlic, parsley, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder until well combined. alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter (28g) 1½ cloves garlic, finely chopped ½ cup warm heavy cream (120ml) 6 oz warm evaporated milk (177ml) ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese (45g) ½ oz cream cheese, optional (14g) ½ tsp salt (3g) ¼ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp onion powder ½ tsp Italian seasoning ½ tbsp fresh parsley, chopped (or ½ tsp dried) Slap Ya Mama, optional 1 tsp roasted garlic and herb seasoning  melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. pour in the warm heavy cream and evaporated milk, then add the salt, black pepper, onion powder, Italian seasoning, parsley, garlic & herb, and Slap Ya Mama  let the sauce gently simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. reduce the heat to low and gradually stir in the parmesan until melted and smooth. add the cream cheese if using and stir until completely melted and creamy. chicken: 1 lb chicken tenderloins 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp salt ¼ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp chicken bouillon powder 1 tbsp olive oil season the chicken tenderloins with the Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, chicken bouillon, and olive oil. heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for about 3–4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. let the chicken rest for a few minutes, then chop into bite-sized pieces. assembly: 8 oz shredded mozzarella cheese slice the Italian loaf in half lengthwise. spread half of the garlic butter evenly over each piece . spread a thin layer of Alfredo sauce over the garlic butter, then top with shredded mozzarella cheese. add the chopped chicken, then drizzle a little more Alfredo sauce over the chicken. bake at 375°F for about 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the edges of the bread are golden. (also don’t add too much Alfredo sauce underneath the cheese or the bread can become soggy. a thin layer is perfect since you’ll be adding another drizzle over the chicken.) #chicken #alfredo #garlicbread #recipe

Chicken Caesar sandwich ✨🥪 Me 🤝 Caesar salad so this was a 10/10 for me!  Ingredients  - 2 chicken breast, sliced thinly - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp paprika  - 1 tsp salt  - 1 tsp pepper  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) Breading - 3 eggs - 1 1/2 cups panko bread crumbs  - 1 cup all purpose flour  - 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded (for breadcrumbs) - Salt and pepper to taste  - Parsley (breadcrumbs) Caesar dressing - 1 cup mayonnaise  - 1/2 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded  -  1 tbsp worcestershire - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1/2 tbsp garlic paste - 1 tsp black pepper  - 1 tsp anchovy paste - 3 cups romaine lettuce, chopped - Salt to taste  Instructions  - In a bowl, combine thinly sliced chicken breast, olive oil, oregano garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, msg if using and pepper. Let marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes (or up to overnight for best flavor). - Set up 3 bowls: flour in one, beaten eggs in another, and panko + Parmesan in the third. - Remove chicken from bowl, then dredge in flour → egg → panko-Parmesan mix. - Heat oil in a skillet (350°F/175°C) and fry chicken cutlets 3–4 mins per side until golden and crispy. - Place on a wire rack or paper towels to drain. - In a large bowl combine mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, anchovy paste, olive oil, Parmesan cheese, garlic paste, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk until well combined. - Add chopped romaine lettuce and mix in until evenly coated. - Add garlic butter to sandwich rolls and toast your sandwich roll lightly. - Spread Caesar dressing on both top and bottom roll. - Add Caesar salad mixture, then place a crispy cutlet on top. - Sprinkle with extra Parmesan, add top of the sandwich roll and serve! • • • #recipes #sandwich #chickencaesar #dinnerideas #lunchideas #girldinner

Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

honey chipotle chicken sandwiches ✨ i will be uploading a newer version of my bun recipe because i tweaked it a bit to make them even softer!  Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Refrigerate for 3 hours minimum or overnight for best results. - Combine all dredge ingredients. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

Vodka chicken Parmesan sandwich on a garlic knot sandwich roll ✨  I got another 10/10 from my husband and I actually tried a piece and can confirm it was sooo good!  Ingredients Chicken - 1.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced - 1 tbsp olive oil - 1 heaping tsp oregano - 1 heaping tsp garlic powder - 1 heaping tsp onion powder - 1 heaping tsp smoked paprika - Salt & pepper, to taste - Avocado oil, for frying - Mozzarella cheese - Pesto, for sandwich Dredge - 1 cup all-purpose flour - 3 eggs, beaten - 1 cup panko breadcrumbs - 1 tbsp parsley, finely chopped - 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded - 1 tbsp garlic powder (1/2tbsp for flour, 1/2 tbsp for panko) - Salt & pepper, to taste Vodka Sauce - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 1 shallot, finely diced - 4 garlic cloves, minced - 3 tbsp tomato paste - 1/4 cup vodka - 1 1/4 cups heavy cream - 2 tbsp unsalted butter - 2/3 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly shredded - 1 heaping tsp oregano - 1 heaping tsp Italian seasoning - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt & pepper, to taste Garlic Knot Sandwich Rolls - 415 g bread flour (3 1/4 cups) - 240 g warm water (1 cup) - 55 g olive oil (1/4 cup) - 38 g granulated sugar (3 tbsp) - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 2 1/4 tsp active dry yeast - 1 tsp salt Garlic Butter - 1/4 cup unsalted butter - 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped - 3 garlic cloves, grated - 1/2 tsp garlic powder - Salt, to taste Instructions Garlic Knot Rolls - In a bowl, combine warm water, sugar, and yeast. Let bloom 5–10 minutes until foamy. - Add olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and flour. Mix until a dough forms. - Knead 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, cover, and rise 1–1½ hours or cold-proof overnight until doubled. - Divide dough into equal pieces. Roll into long ropes and tie into loose figure-8 knots, stretching slightly to elongate. - Cover and rise 30–45 minutes. - Brush with egg wash and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 16–20 minutes until golden. - Melt butter and mix with garlic, parsley, garlic powder, and salt. Brush generously over warm rolls. Vodka Sauce - Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Add olive oil, add shallots and cook 2–3 minutes until softened. - Add garlic and cook until fragrant. - Stir in tomato paste and cook 2–3 minutes until slightly darkened and caramelized. - Deglaze with vodka, scraping the pan. Simmer 1–2 minutes until reduced. - Add oregano, Italian seasoning, and red chili flakes. - Lower heat to medium-low and stir in heavy cream. Simmer gently 4–5 minutes. - Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan a little at a time until smooth. - Add butter and mix until glossy. Season with salt and pepper. Chicken - Toss chicken with olive oil, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. - Dredge in flour → egg → panko, pressing to adhere. - Fry in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack. - Spoon a thin layer of vodka sauce over chicken, top with mozzarella, and broil 2–3 minutes until melted. - Split garlic knot rolls. - Spread pesto on the top bun. - Spoon vodka sauce on the bottom bun. - Add crispy chicken. - Finish with more vodka sauce. - Close, press gently, and serve warm. • • • #recipe #chickenrecipe #dinnerideas #recipeideas #chickenparm

Looks can be deceiving, much like how this meal looks like it took you hours to prepare! 😉 This Parmesan Ranch Chicken is as easy as one, two, three! Continue reading or click the link in the @allrecipes bio to get the full recipe! 🔗 Ingredients: 6 skinless, boneless chicken cutlets 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/2 cup plain yogurt 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 2 tablespoons ranch seasoning mix 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 2 green onions, thinly sliced Directions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). If using whole chicken breasts, cut them in half lengthwise to form 6 chicken cutlets. Arrange chicken in a single layer in the bottom of a lightly greased  baking dish. In a medium bowl, stir together mayonnaise, yogurt, Parmesan, ranch seasoning, salt, and pepper until well combined. School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. The chicken bouillon and chicken rub already contain salt, so you may not need much! #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinnerideas #easydinner

Trying @Allyssainthekitchen smothered chicken thighs… and they did not disappoint! 🤤🍗 It was SO tender and flavorful!!    🛒 Ingredients • Chicken thighs • Carrots • Onion • 2 cups chicken broth • Olive oil 🧂Seaaonings: Salt, pepper, garlic and onion powder, paprika, red pepper flakes, thyme, rosemary.  🫙For the gravy:  •3 tbsp cornstarch •3 tbsp cold water 👩‍🍳 How to Make 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place the chicken thighs in a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and seasonings. Toss to coat, then arrange the chicken in an even layer. 3. Tuck the carrots and onion wedges between the chicken. 4. Pour 2 cups chicken broth into the baking dish. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour 30 minutes. 6. Carefully drain the cooking liquid into a bowl. 7. Whisk together the cornstarch and cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. (If needed, add a little more slurry until it reaches your desired consistency). 8. Pour the gravy back over the chicken, increase the oven temperature to 450°F, and bake uncovered for 20 minutes. 9. Serve over rice, mashed potatoes, or enjoy by itself! #ChickenRecipe #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #OvenBakedChicken #DinnerIdeas

Soup on Sunday: Marry Me Chicken Soup 💍🍗 Marry Me Chicken is one of my FAVORITE dishes and when I found a soup recipe inspired by it, I asked zero questions. I did find that I wanted to add more broth than the original recipe called for and I also don’t think the cream cheese is 100% necessary. It looked perfectly creamy without it, BUT I wanted to give the original recipe a shot. But do what sounds best to you!! Recipe by: Savor & Nest • ½ cup sun-dried tomatoes (julienne-cut, packed in oil with herbs) • 1 tbsp oil from sun-dried tomato jar • 1 ½ cups chopped yellow onion • 4-6 cloves garlic, minced • 3 tbsp tomato paste • 6-8 cups chicken broth, depending on how thick you want it • 1 cup heavy whipping cream • 4 tsp fresh basil (plus more for garnish) • 2 tsp kosher salt • 1 ½ tsp dried Italian seasoning • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp crushed red pepper (or more if you like heat) • 8 oz uncooked medium shell pasta • 3 cups fresh baby spinach, roughly chopped • 2 cups shredded rotisserie chicken • 8 oz cream cheese, cubed (room temperature) • 1 ½ oz Parmesan cheese, finely shredded (plus more for garnish) INSTRUCTIONS:  • Heat 1 tablespoon of sun-dried tomato oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onions and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened, then add and cook garlic until fragrant. • Stir in tomato paste and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the tomato paste deepens in color. • Pour in the chicken broth, cream, basil, salt, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and crushed red pepper. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Let it simmer for 12 minutes. • Add the pasta, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender. • Lower the heat to low, then stir in spinach, shredded chicken, cream cheese, and Parmesan. Stir often for 5 minutes until the cheeses melt and the chicken is warmed through. • Ladle into bowls, garnish with extra Parmesan. #soup #marrymechickensoup #easyrecipe #food #souprecipe

Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Cheesy BBQ Chicken sliders are a super easy dinner that my family loves! INGREDIENTS 12 count Hawaiian Original Rolls Olive oil  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes 1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning  1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese  BBQ sauce  1 cup shredded Colby Jack cheese  6 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled  Crispy onions  2 tbsp butter 1/2 tsp each garlic powder and dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 lb of cubed chicken to the skillet with some olive oil. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. Stir well and cook until the chicken is fully cooked reaching an internal temperature of 165 degrees F.  Slice Hawaiian Original Rolls in half. Add a layer of shredded mozzarella cheese and top with the cooked chicken. Drizzle some BBQ  sauce over the chicken and top with shredded Colby Jack cheese. Sprinkle on some crumbled bacon and crispy onions. Place the tops of the rolls on the sliders.  Mix together 2 tbsp of melted butter with garlic powder and dried parsley. Brush this over the tops of the sliders. Bake the sliders in the oven at 350 degrees F for 10-15 minutes. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinner #sliderrecipes

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Crockpot Chicken Pasta Ingredients • 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tbsp Kinder’s Buttery Garlic & Herb Seasoning • 1 jar marinara sauce (24 oz) • 1 jar Alfredo sauce (15 oz) • 1 block cream cheese (8 oz) • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 1 bag shredded mozzarella cheese (8 oz) • Parsley flakes, for garnish Instructions 1. Add the chicken breasts to the crockpot and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and Kinder’s Buttery Garlic & Herb Seasoning. 2. Pour in the marinara sauce and Alfredo sauce. Add the cream cheese and minced garlic, then gently mix everything together. 3. Cover and cook on HIGH for 3 hours, or until the chicken is fully cooked and tender. 4. Remove the chicken, shred it with two forks, and return it to the crockpot. 5. Add the shredded mozzarella cheese and stir until the cheese is melted and everything is creamy and combined. 6. Top with parsley flakes and serve. #crockpotrecipes #chickenpasta #slowcookerrecipes #easyrecipes #comfortfood

If you need an easy dinner recipe using a pound of ground beef, this Sloppy Joe Potato Skillet won’t disappoint!  INGREDIENTS  5 small/medium potatoes olive oil + salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika (for potatoes) 1 lb ground beef  1 chopped onion  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper  1 tsp onion powder and paprika  1 tbsp minced garlic  1-2 tbsp Worcestershire  8 oz can tomato sauce  1/4 cup ketchup  1 tbsp mustard  2 tbsp bbq sauce  1 1/2 cups shredded Colby Jack cheese  Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  Peel, wash, and cut potatoes up into cubes.  Toss them with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  Cook the potatoes in the air fryer at 400 degrees F for about 20-25 minutes shaking them around at least a couple of times while they cook.  Once the potatoes are cooking, brown the ground beef and onion in a skillet and add all seasonings.  Add minced garlic, Worcestershire, tomato sauce, ketchup, mustard, and bbq sauce. Let simmer on low until the potatoes are ready.  Add crispy potatoes to the skillet with the sloppy joe mix and give it a quick stir. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top and put in the oven under broil just to melt the cheese.  Enjoy! #easyrecipes #dinner #sloppyjoes

Easy chicken pot pie recipe 😍 so easy and delicious! Full recipe below ⬇️  Ingredients:  -3 chicken breast  -1 chopped onion  -1 tbsp butter -4 chopped garlic cloves  -1 tsp salt  -1/2 tsp pepper  -1 tsp dried parsley  -2 chicken stock pots  -2 heaped tbsp flour  -350ml milk  -frozen mixed veg -100ml water  -1 roll puff pastry  -1 egg for egg wash  -sprinkle of rosemary  Method:  -place your chopped onion and garlic into a pan on medium heat with a splash of oil and a tbsp of butter to soften up  -add in your chicken diced up to bite size pieces and your 2 stick cubes and stir every few minutes until chicken is fully cooked -once your chicken is cooked through, add in your flour and cook for 5 minutes, then your milk, keep stirring this around until it thickens up nicely  -once thick, add in your frozen veg and your water, mix well and leave to cook for another 5 minutes or so until it’s at the consistency you like, then set to one side to cool -roll out your puff pastry sheet and cut into small squares and place them along the top of your pie mix so it’s all covered then cover with egg wash  -place on the oven for 25-30 minutes on 200 degrees Celsius or until golden and crispy on top (if you don’t have a oven safe pan, place your mix into a oven dish and do the same process)  -once done, sprinkle with a little salt and rosemary and enjoy! Chicken Flautas Every week pls!✨😮‍💨  #easymeals #quickrecipes #onepotmeals #mealsonabudget #DinnerIdeas  Ingredients:  * 2–4 chicken breasts * 2 tbsp chicken bouillon * 1 onion * 6 garlic cloves, divided * 3 tomatoes * 1 jalapeño * 3 arbol chiles * ¼ cup water (or chicken broth) * Salt & pepper * Corn tortillas * Canola or vegetable oil * Sour cream * Shredded lettuce * Diced tomatoes * Diced onion * Pinto beans & Mexican rice, for serving Directions: Boil the chicken breasts with chicken bouillon, 1/2 of the onion, and 3 garlic cloves until fully cooked. For the salsa, toast the 3 tomatoes, 1 jalapeño, 3 garlic cloves, arbol chiles, and remaining onion in a little oil. Add to a blender with ¼ cup water (or chicken broth) and season with salt, pepper, and chicken bouillon. Blend until smooth. Let the chicken cool, then shred and season to taste. Warm the tortillas, fill with chicken, and roll tightly. Fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. Top the flautas with salsa, sour cream, shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, and diced onion. Serve with pinto beans and Mexican rice.

Meals for Weight-loss:  Mexican Chicken Corn Salad Ingredients:  Chicken * Chicken breast, 800 g * Lime juice, 2 tbsp * Avocado oil, 1 tbsp * Chili powder, 2 tsp * Cumin, 1.5 tsp * Garlic powder, 1 tsp * Paprika, 1 tsp * Salt, 1 tsp * Black pepper, 0.5 tsp Veggies * Cotija cheese, 50 g * Red onion, 1 large, finely diced * Red bell pepper, 1 large, finely diced * Cilantro, 1 handful, chopped * Jalapeños, 3, finely diced * Canned corn, 2 cups total, drained and charred Sauce * Plain 0% Greek yogurt, 1 cup * Lime juice, from 0.5 lime * Hot sauce, 1 tbsp * Tajín, 1 tbsp * Water, 0.5 cup * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add it to a bowl with lime juice, avocado oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. 2. Heat a large pan on medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and fully cooked to 165°F. 3. Drain the canned corn really well and pat it dry with paper towel. In the same pan or a clean hot pan, add the corn in a single layer and let it sit untouched for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir and cook another 2 to 3 minutes until charred in spots. 4. In a bowl, mix Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt, and black pepper until smooth. 5. In a large bowl, add the charred corn, red onion, red bell pepper, cilantro, jalapeños, and cotija cheese. 6. Pour in the sauce and mix everything until coated. 7. Divide the chicken and street corn salad mixture into 4 servings. Store chilled and eat within 3 to 4 days. Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Start by seasoning your chicken breast with chipotle seasoning, olive oil & mix. 2. Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken with a lid for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side or until fully cooked through, once cooked shred the chicken apart using 2 forks. 3. In a blender cup add low fat cottage cheese, chipotle seasoning, light mayonnaise, garlic, lime juice, chipotle in adobo sauce, buffalo sauce, honey & blend for 2 minutes until smooth & creamy. 4. In a large bowl combined the blended chipotle sauce, shredded chicken, chives & grated cheese until well combined. 5. Place a warm tortilla down & to one half add a layer of cheese followed by 1/10th of the filling, another layer of cheese & fold. 6. New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Chicken and Red Lentil Soup by @nytcooking @andybaraghani Ingredients - 3 tbsp olive oil - 2 large onions, thinly sliced - 6 garlic cloves, thinly sliced - 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs - 1½ cups red lentils, rinsed - 1 tsp ground turmeric - Salt & black pepper - 1 cup mixed herbs (parsley, dill, mint) - 1 cup plain full-fat yogurt (regular or Greek) - 2 tbsp lemon juice Steps: Heat oil in a large pot and cook the onions until deeply caramelized, then add the garlic and soften it. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. CHICKEN KEBAB #food #recipe #chicken #kebab GROUND CHICKEN 50 g red bell pepper, finely diced 50 g green bell pepper, finely diced 15 g fresh parsley, finely chopped 100 g yellow onion (1 onion), finely chopped 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped 7 g salt (1⅙ tsp) 5 g ground cumin (1⅔ tsp) 5 g paprika (1⅔ tsp) 1 g chili flakes 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 2 g black pepper (⅔ tsp) lemon juice (½ lemon) 45 ml olive oil 750 g ground chicken WRAP wraps vegetables of your choice sauce of your choice Ready all the ingredients. Add the red bell pepper, green bell pepper, fresh parsley, yellow onion, and garlic to a food processor. Blend until you have a vegetable mixture. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a large, deep bowl. Add the salt, ground cumin, paprika, chili flakes, cayenne pepper, black pepper, lemon juice, olive oil, and ground chicken. Knead until combined. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread the chicken mixture evenly over the baking sheet and press it down firmly. Then cut the mixture into straight strips. Use a spoon to press half-moon shapes next to each other. Place the kebab in a preheated oven at 225°C (440°F). Bake for 20–25 minutes. Then switch the oven to the grill setting and grill for 5 minutes, or until the top is nicely golden brown and slightly crispy. Take a wrap and spread with your desired sauce. Fill the wrap with vegetables and pieces of kebab. Fold the wrap until closed. Grill the filled wrap until the wrap is nicely crispy and golden brown.

Raspberry cheesecake donuts ✨ Ingredients  Donuts - 435g bread flour (3 cups + 2 tbsp) - 68g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 185g whole milk (3/4 cup) - 60g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 7g active dry yeast (2 1/4 tsp) - 2 large eggs - 1 tsp vanilla extract  - 1/2 tsp salt - Canola oil for frying Raspberry jam - 300g raspberries (about 2 cups) - 225g granulated sugar (1 cup + 2 tbsp) - Juice of 1/2 lemon - Cornstarch slurry Cheesecake filling - 5 oz cream cheese, softened  - 250g powdered sugar (2 cups) - 57g unsalted butter, softened (4 tbsp) - 45g heavy cream (3 tbsp) - 2 tsp vanilla extract - 1 dolop of raspberry jam - 1/4 tsp salt  Raspberry sugar  - 15g freeze dried raspberries, blended (about 1 cup) - 120g granulated sugar (1/2 cup) Instructions  - In a large bowl, bloom the yeast with 1 tbsp honey in the warm milk for 5–10 minutes, or until foamy - Add eggs, sugar, vanilla extract and mix until well combined. - Add the flour and salt, then mix until a shaggy consistency  - Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface (or use a stand mixer) and knead for 10–20 minutes, adding 1 tbsp of softened butter at a time until fully incorporated. Continue kneading until the dough is smooth, elastic, and passes the windowpane test. - Transfer dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let rise 1–1½ hours, or until doubled in size. - While the dough rises, make the raspberry jam by cooking the raspberries, sugar, and lemon juice until thick. Add a cornstarch slurry if needed. Let cool. - Beat together the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, heavy cream, vanilla, salt, and a dollop of raspberry jam until fluffy. Refrigerate both fillings while the dough rises, then let them sit at room temperature before filling. - Punch down dough and separate into 12 balls (weighing 65g each) - Place the dough balls on a parchment-lined baking tray, leaving space between each. - Cover loosely and let rise for 30–40 minutes, or until puffy. When gently poked, the dough should slowly spring back, leaving a slight indentation. - In a large skillet heat oil to 315–335°F (aim for 330°F) - Fry the donuts, flipping every 30–45 seconds, until evenly golden brown and cooked through (about 2–3 minutes total). - Transfer the donuts to a wire rack to drain for 1–2 minutes. - Mix the freeze-dried raspberry powder with the sugar, then coat the warm donuts. - Poke a hole in each donut, then pipe in the raspberry jam followed by the cheesecake filling. • • • #baking #recipes #recipeideas #bakingideas #donuts

Korean Popcorn Chicken 🍿🍗 This is one of my personal all-time favorite high-protein dinners. Crispy chicken tossed in a Korean sauce that’s sweet, savory and full of flavor. Air fried or oven baked, this is one that will for sure end up in your weekly rotation. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that help you eat better and spend less. Follow me for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Chicken • 2 lb chicken breast (or thighs), cut into bite-size pieces • 2 eggs • 3 tbsp soy sauce • ¾ tsp salt • ¾ tsp black pepper • 1½ tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp ginger powder Crispy Coating • 1 cup cornstarch • 3 tbsp flour • ¾ tsp baking powder Korean Sauce • ⅓ cup gochujang • 3 tbsp brown sugar • 3 tbsp ketchup • 4 tbsp honey • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 3 tbsp rice vinegar • 1½ tbsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp butter Garnish • green onions • sesame seeds Instructions 1.	In a large bowl, combine the chicken, eggs, soy sauce, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and ginger powder. Mix until the chicken is fully coated. 2.	Add the cornstarch, flour, and baking powder. Toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 3.	Cook the chicken. Air fryer: Preheat to 400°F. Cook for 8 minutes, flip the chicken, then cook another 4 minutes until crispy. Oven: Bake at 425°F for 15–20 minutes, flipping halfway through. 4.	In a pan over medium heat, combine the gochujang, brown sugar, ketchup, honey, garlic, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil. Let it simmer for 3–4 minutes until thick, then turn off the heat and whisk in the butter. 5.	Add the crispy chicken to a bowl and pour in about ½ cup of the sauce. Toss until fully coated, adding more sauce if needed. 6.	Serve over rice and top with green onions and sesame seeds. #easyrecipe #koreanchicken #popcornchicken #koreanpopcornchicken

EASY MEALS FOR 2, EP. 24 🍯 Honey Garlic Chicken Ingredients Chicken * 375g-400g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp black pepper * ¼ cup cornstarch Sauce * 60g honey (about 3 tbsp) * 2 tbsp soy sauce * 1 tbsp oyster sauce * 1 tbsp rice vinegar * 19g garlic, minced (4–5 large cloves) * 12g green onion whites, finely sliced Cornstarch Slurry * 1 tsp cornstarch * 2 tsp water Garnish * Sesame seeds * Sliced green onion greens Directions 1. Toss the chicken with the salt, garlic powder, pepper, and cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Heat enough neutral oil to lightly coat the bottom of a pan. Shallow fry the chicken over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. 3. Reduce to medium heat. If needed, add a little more oil, then sauté the garlic and green onion whites for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the honey, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and rice vinegar. Simmer for 1–2 minutes. 5. Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens. 6. Return the chicken to the pan and toss until every piece is well coated. 7. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions greens Serve with steamed rice and enjoy! 🍚 #honeygarlicchicken #chickenrecipe #easyrecipe #cooking #creatorsearchinsights

Crockpot Marry Me Chicken Sandwiches INGREDIENTS 1 lb chicken breast  1/2 tsp each salt, pepper, oregano, thyme 1 tsp each onion powder and garlic powder 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes 1 tbsp minced garlic 1/3 cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped  1/2 cup of chicken broth  8 slices of bacon  1 block of cream cheese 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese Brioche buns  INSTRUCTIONS  Spray a crockpot with cooking spray and add the chicken. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, onion powder, garlic powder, and red pepper flakes. Next, add the minced garlic, chopped sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth.  Be sure to stir the sun dried tomatoes and garlic around. You want the sun dried tomatoes to be down in the chicken broth, so they don’t burn.  Cook on low for 4-6 hours. Once the chicken is fully cooked shred the chicken, add a block of cream cheese, and shredded mozzarella cheese. Let this keep cooking on low until the cream cheese is melted and stir everything together well.  Cook bacon while cream cheese is melting. Once bacon is cooked build sandwiches on toasted buns and top with the crispy bacon. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #crockpot

Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. Longsoran es itu menghantam danau di bawahnya, menciptakan gelombang raksasa yang menjebol bendungan alami — bendungan yang selama ini menahan jutaan kubik air. Dalam hitungan menit, air bah bercampur lumpur dan bongkahan es menerjang Sungai Bhote Koshi, menyapu Timmire, lalu Syabrubesi, dan Rasuwagadhi. Rumah-rumah hancur. Jalan terputus. Ratusan keluarga kehilangan tempat tinggal dalam sekejap. Hasilnya: lebih dari 160 orang dilaporkan meninggal dunia, dan 700 lainnya masih hilang hingga kini. Ini adalah pengingat — bahwa perubahan iklim bukan lagi ancaman masa depan. Ia sudah terjadi, hari ini, di depan mata kita. #banjir  #nepal  #pray  #prayfornepal  #beritaviral

Crispy Rice Paper Burger 🍔  2 sheets rice paper 1 egg, whisked 1 cooked beef burger patty 2 slices smoked cheese 1 tbsp burger sauce 2–3 sweet & spicy pickle slices 2–3 large cos lettuce leaves Method 1. Dip both sheets of rice paper into the whisked egg until completely coated, then stack them on top of each other. 2. Press the stacked rice paper into a small bowl to create a cup shape. 3. Layer in 1 slice of smoked cheese, the cooked burger patty, burger sauce, sweet & spicy pickles and the remaining slice of smoked cheese. 4. Fold the edges of the rice paper over the filling, pressing them down to enclose the burger. 5. Carefully flip the parcel out of the bowl and place seam-side down in the air fryer basket. 6. Air fry at 190°C for 8–10 minutes, flipping halfway, until deeply golden and crispy. Keep an eye on it towards the end as rice paper can brown quickly. 7. Wrap the crispy burger in cos lettuce and serve immediately. #dinner #recipe #burger

Save this for an easy weeknight meal you’ll keep coming back to 🌯💛 RECIPE⬇️ Creamy Chicken Mushroom Wraps Servings: 4 wraps Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 20 minutes Ingredients: For the Chicken: * 2 chicken breasts, diced * 1 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper * ½ tsp salt For the Mushroom Mixture: * 1 tbsp butter * 1 cup mushrooms, sliced * ½ medium onion, finely chopped For the Secret Sauce: * ¼ cup mayonnaise * 2+ tbsp creamy pasta sauce * 1 tsp sriracha (adjust to taste) Additional Ingredients: * 1 cup spinach, chopped * ¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped * ½ cup shredded cheese (mozzarella, cheddar, or a blend) * 4 large tortillas Instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the diced chicken and season. Cook for 8–10 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and golden brown. Remove from heat and set aside. 2. In the different pan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and chopped onions, and sauté for about 5 minutes, or until softened and golden brown. 3. Add in the mayonnaise, creamy pasta sauce, and sriracha. 4. Return the cooked chicken to the pan with the mushroom mixture. Stir in the spinach and cilantro. Add the shredded cheese and stir until melted and combined. 5. Place a tortilla flat on a clean surface. Spoon a generous amount of the chicken and mushroom filling into the center. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly to form a wrap. 6. Heat a dry skillet over medium heat.
