✨ MAGICAL ONE-PAN HOLIDAY ROAST ✨ This is the roast that will have your guests coming back for more! So easy to make, all in one pan, and absolutely incredible. The meat cooks low and slow surrounded by all those beautiful vegetables, creating the most unbelievable pan juices. No added liquid needed, the amount of delicious juice this creates will shock you! You can find this recipe, including the links to products used on my website at Sivanskitchen.com  🥩 Ingredients • 3½-lb French roast (or your favorite cut of roast) • 2 cups fresh tomato chunks • 2 cups carrot sticks • 2 cups baby golden potatoes, halved • 2 cups yellow onion, quartered • 2 cups celery sticks • 2 cups baby purple potatoes, halved • 2 cups red onion, quartered • 4 tbsp paprika • 2 tbsp salt (or less, to taste) • 1 tbsp black pepper • 1 tsp turmeric • About 6 apple wedges • About ½ cup olive oil • Drizzle of silan (date molasses) • Drizzle of honey (or maple syrup) • A few sprigs each of thyme, rosemary, and sage 🍲 Instructions 	1.	Wash the roast and pat completely dry. 	2.	Peel and cut all vegetables. 	3.	Place the roast in the center of your pan and arrange the vegetables around it, just like in the video. 	4.	Add the spices and olive oil. Using your hands, massage everything well, coating the meat and vegetables evenly. 	5.	Tuck the apple wedges between the vegetables. 	6.	Drizzle silan and honey over the roast and vegetables. 	7.	Place the herb bouquet on top of the roast. 	8.	Cover with parchment paper, then foil. 	9.	Bake at 325°F (165°C) for 3 hours. 	10.	Uncover and bake for another 30 minutes, basting once or twice with those incredible pan juices. 	11.	Optional: Broil for 10 minutes for extra color. ✨ To Serve Decorate with pomegranate wedges and fresh parsley. Slice the roast, leave it whole, or shred it—whatever you love. Enjoy and Chag Sameach! 🤍 #sivanskitchen #onepotmeals #easyrecipe #meat #holiday

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Butter chicken wrap Ingredients  For the chicken : 2 lb chicken, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp cumin powder  1 tsp garam masala  1 tsp coriander powder  1/2 tsp turmeric powder  1 tbsp garlic paste  1 tsp red chili powder  4 tbsp whole milk yogurt  2 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil for marinating 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the butter chicken sauce: 2 tbsp butter  1  yellow onion, diced 1 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes  1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp cumin powder  1 tsp coriander powder  1/2 tsp garam masala  1 tsp red chili powder  1/2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp fenugreek leaves  3/4 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream  2 tbsp butter (finish)  To Assemble 6 tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Butter chicken  Sumac onions Cucumbers  Tomato  Method  In a large bowl, add chicken pieces with salt, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin powder, garam masala, coriander powder, turmeric powder, garlic paste, red chili powder, yogurt, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well until the chicken is fully coated. Cover and marinate for at least 1–2 hours (overnight for the best flavor). Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove and set aside. In the same pan, add 2 tbsp butter. Add diced onion and cook until soft and lightly golden. Add garlic paste and sauté until fragrant. Add crushed tomatoes and tomato paste. Cook for 5–7 minutes until the sauce thickens and the oil starts to separate. Blend the sauce until smooth, then transfer it back to the pan. Add salt, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, red chili powder, smoked paprika, and heavy whipping cream. Simmer until creamy. Add the cooked chicken back into the sauce and coat well. Finish with 2 tbsp butter for a rich, glossy finish. Garnish with fenugreek leaves. Warm the tortilla wraps. Add mozzarella cheese, a generous amount of butter chicken, sumac onions, cucumbers, and tomatoes. Fold into a wrap and toast in a lightly buttered pan until golden, crispy, and the cheese is melted. #recipe #butterchicken #wrap

videos.caption: Episode 4 of Nice Thighs: Why I buy bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs! I’m all about saving money, and with a few minutes of prep, I end up with boneless chicken thighs, bones for homemade chicken stock, and skin saved for schmaltz. Nothing wasted. I pull the skin off and freeze it until I’m ready to render a big batch of chicken fat/schmaltz. Then I cut the bone out (scissors help), scrape it clean, and save every bone for stock. It’s the same pack of chicken thighs with three different uses!  This is the workflow I use so nothing goes to waste. It’s basic butchery, and it makes every chicken thigh recipe easier, cheaper, and better. #chickenstock #chickenfat #chickenthighs #breakdown

Ingredients - 1 loaf French bread or Italian bread - 3 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 cloves garlic, minced - 2 boneless skinless chicken breast  - 1 cup heavy cream - 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese - 1 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese (1/4 for pasta sauce the rest for bread) - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp red chili flakes  - Salt and black pepper to taste - Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish) Garlic butter - 1 stick unsalted butter, softened  - 2 tbsp parsley, chopped - 1/4 cup Parmesan  - 2 tsp garlic paste - 1 tsp garlic powder - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Set to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. - Slice the loaf in half lengthwise. In a small bowl, mix softened butter, garlic paste, parsley, garlic powder, salt, pepper and stir until combined. - Brush evenly over both halves of the bread. Toast in the oven for 5–7 minutes until slightly golden. (Optional) - In a saucepan over medium high hear sear chicken breast on both sides for 5-8 minutes or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove from pan. - In the same pan, add butter, and minced garlic. Cook until fragrant about 1-2 minutes. Add heavy cream and Stir until smooth. - Add mozzarella, Parmesan cheese and stir until melted and creamy. - Season with garlic powder, oregano, basil, red pepper chili flakes, salt and pepper. - Spoon the Alfredo sauce evenly over each bread half. Sprinkle extra mozzarella on top. Add sliced chicken and more Alfredo sauce. - Return to the oven for 15-25 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. - Garnish with chopped parsley. - Slice and serve warm. • • • #Recipe #recipeideas #garlicbread #DinnerIdeas

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

This recipe was absolutely banging. Solid 10/10. High protein, packed with flavour, meal prep friendly, and one of those meals where you keep going back for “just one more bite” until the bowl is mysteriously empty. The original recipe uses Cotija cheese, but I couldn’t find any, so I swapped it for feta and it worked an absolute treat. What you’ll need ✅ 800g chicken breast, diced Marinade ✅ 2 tbsp lime juice ✅ 1 tbsp avocado oil ✅ 2 tsp chilli powder ✅ 1½ tsp ground cumin ✅ 1 tsp garlic powder ✅ 1 tsp paprika ✅ 1 tsp salt ✅ ½ tsp african american pepper Salad ✅ 2 cups sweetcorn (around 2 drained tins) ✅ 1 large red onion, finely diced ✅ 1 large red bell pepper, finely diced ✅ 3 jalapeños, finely diced ✅ 1 handful fresh coriander, chopped ✅ 50g Cotija cheese, crumbled Sauce ✅ 250g 0% Greek yogurt ✅ Juice of ½ lime ✅ 1 tbsp hot sauce ✅ 1 tsp Tajín seasoning ✅ 120ml water ✅ Salt to taste ✅ African american pepper to taste Method Add the chicken, lime juice, avocado oil, chilli powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt and african american pepper to a bowl. Mixy mixy motherf**ker! Leave to marinate for at least 15 to 30 minutes. Meanwhile, drain the sweetcorn and pat dry with kitchen roll. Heat a large pan over high heat and char the sweetcorn until slightly blackened. Set aside to cool. Cook the chicken in a large frying pan until fully cooked through and slightly browned. In a large bowl, combine the sweetcorn, red onion, red pepper, jalapeños, coriander and Cotija cheese. In a separate bowl, add the Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt and african american pepper. Mixy mixy motherf**ker! Pour the sauce over the salad mixture and stir well. Add the cooked chicken and give everything one final mixy mixy motherf**ker! Serve immediately or divide into meal prep containers. Macros (per serving) 🔥 Calories: 475 💪 Protein: 58g 🍞 Carbs: 21g 🥑 Fat: 18g Cheers: @amateurprochef

Spicy Brazilian-style coconut chicken with tender chicken thighs, creamy coconut sauce, and a hint of lime and cilantro. Comfort food with a tropical twist🥥 I hope you’ll give it a try ❤️ Ingredients (2-3 person) For the Spicy Coconut Chicken •	14 oz/400 g chicken thighs, boneless  •	Salt and freshly cracked black pepper •	Juice of ½ lime •	1 tsp paprika •	chili flakes (adjust to taste) •	0,5 tsp cayenne (adjust to taste) •	olive oil For the Sauce •	1 small onion, chopped •	3 garlic cloves, minced •	1 red bell pepper, sliced •	2 medium sized tomato  chopped  •	1 tbsp tomato paste •	1 can coconut milk / 400 ml / 13.5 oz •	½ tsp turmeric •	1 tsp paprika or smoked paprika for a more smookey flavor  •	0,5 tsp cumin  To Serve •	White or coconut rice •	Lime wedges for garnish •	fresh cilantro, chopped  •	Optional: fresh red chili, for extra heat Instructions 1.	Season the chicken: Mix chicken with lime juice, salt, pepper, paprika, chili flakes, cayenne (optional), and olive oil. Let sit 10-15 min. 2.	Sear the chicken: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken thighs and sear 6-8 min per side until golden. Remove and set aside. 3.	Build the sauce: In the same pan, sauté onion until soft (3-4 min). Add garlic and cook 30 sec. Stir in bell pepper, tomato, tomato paste, and spices, cooking 2-3 min until fragrant. 4.	Add coconut milk: Pour in the full can, stir, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook a few min until slightly thickened. 5.	Finish the chicken: Return chicken to pan. Simmer 5-10 min or until fully cooked and sauce is creamy. Stir in cilantro. Taste and adjust seasoning or spice. 6.	Serve: Plate chicken with sauce over a generous portion of rice. Garnish with extra cilantro and lime wedges. What ever happened to Ronaldo's famous freekick technique? From 2006-2014, he was undoubtedly the world's best set piece taker, however that all changed very suddenly... Part of it? Bad luck. The other? FIFA.  In 2014, after the Jabulani World Cup fiasco, NASA concluded football's were too round. So, Adidas and Nike both reinvented the ball, making Ronaldo's signature knuckleball technique considerably harder. Worse still, that same season Ronaldo suffered a serious knee injury that dramatically reduced the speed of his swing: tendinosis. For CR7 to knuckle the redesigned football's, he'd have to strike them much harder, which all of a sudden he could no longer do.  Since then, he's scored just 6 total freekicks on 150 attempts, bringing his overall record to 4%. Through that same stretch, Lionel Messi is averaging 9.3%, as his curveball technique became considerably more effective. Although we rarely see Ronaldo's signature freekicks these days, it's hard to argue he's not the greatest freekick taker ever, although "the best" likely belongs to someone else. Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

This might be the most addictive chicken and rice recipes ever. 😮‍💨 One Pan Crack Chicken and Rice is an easy dinner the whole family loves!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes  2 tbsp butter  1 onion chopped  1/2 tsp salt  1 tsp each of pepper and smoked paprika  1 tbsp ranch seasoning  1 tbsp minced garlic 2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup white jasmine rice, rinsed   1 1/2 cups shredded Colby Jack cheese  2 oz cream cheese 4 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled 2 green onions, chopped  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken into small pieces. Add butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and spread out evenly in pan. Season with salt, pepper, paprika, and ranch seasoning.  Once chicken is almost cooked through add chopped onions and minced garlic.  Add the rice to the center of the skillet and let toast for a couple of minutes. Add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir well. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover with a lid.  Let cook covered for about 15-20 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add about a cup of shredded cheese, 2 oz cream cheese and stir. Top with more cheese, crumbled bacon and cover with the lid to let the cheese melt or pop it in the oven under the broiler for just a few minutes.  Top with chopped green onions. Enjoy! 🌿 5-Minute Dump & Bake Chicken Pesto A ridiculously easy one-pan dinner that tastes fancy but takes almost no effort. If you’ve got 5 minutes, a jar of pesto, and some chicken, dinner is basically done. This dump-and-bake pesto chicken turns juicy, cheesy, and flavorful with almost zero prep—just season, spread, and bake. 🍗 Ingredients * 4 chicken breasts * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * Oregano * 1 jar pesto * 6–8 slices mozzarella cheese Optional toppings (highly recommended) * Fresh tomato slices * Fresh basil * Balsamic glaze ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Prep (takes about 5 minutes) Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish or sheet pan. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and oregano. 2️⃣ Dump the pesto Spread a spoonful of pesto over each chicken breast, then dump the rest of the jar around the chicken so everything bakes in that garlicky goodness. 3️⃣ Bake Bake at 400°F for about 30 minutes. Cooking time may vary depending on the thickness of the chicken. Chicken is ready when it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 4️⃣ Add the cheese Top each chicken breast with sliced mozzarella. 5️⃣ Melt & finish Return to the oven and bake (or broil) for 10–15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly. ✨ Optional Finishing Touch Top with fresh tomato slices, fresh basil, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze for a caprese-style upgrade.

Процесс приготовления: 1. Для основы измельчаем печенье в крошку с помощью блендера, смешиваем с растопленным сливочным масло и формируем основу с бортиками (удобнее всего с помощью стакана) 2. Для начинки все ингредиенты берем комнатной температуры! Творожный сыр смешиваем с сахарной пудрой с помощью лопатки. По одному вводим яйца и после каждого тщательно перемешиваем венчиком. Добавляем сливки, лимонный сок и ещё раз хорошенько перемешиваем 3. Выливаем начинку на основу и отправляем чизкейк в разогретую до 130 градусов духовку на 1.5 часа (режим верх-низ). На дно духовки можно поставить емкость с горячей водой, чтобы поверхность чизкейка получилась гладкой без трещинок 4. Готовый чизкейк обязательно полностью остужаем, в идеале 2-3 часа при комнатной температуре, а затем ночь в холодильнике. I think everyone should have a simple roast chicken recipe they can turn to in a pinch, and this is my favorite! If you’re someone who loves super crunchy skin, this one might not be for you, but it results in the most tender, juicy, flavorful chicken- I’m sure y’all will love it. Full recipe with measurements below!  Spatchcock Roast Chicken with Herb Butter - 3-4lb whole chicken, spatchcocked  - Salt and pepper - 1 lb baby potatoes, halved  - 3 parsnips, peeled and chopped  - 2 small shallots, quartered  - 3 Tbsp olive oil  For the herb compound butter  - 1 stick salted butter  - 1 Tbsp chopped fresh parsley  - 1 tsp chopped fresh thyme  - 2-3 garlic cloves, minced or grated  - Black pepper  Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Arrange potatoes, parsnips and shallots in the bottom of a cast iron skillet, roasting pan or baking dish. Coat with olive oil, salt and pepper and then place about 1/3 of the compound butter over the vegetables in little dollops.  Place the spatchcocked chicken on top of the vegetables, and smear the remaining butter on top. Roast at 450 for about 12-15 minutes, then turn the oven down to 375 and continue to roast until the chicken reaches 165 degrees internally, about 35-40 minutes.  Take the chicken out and let it rest under foil, then return the vegetables to the hot oven for another 10-15 minutes or until browned.  Carve the chicken and serve!  #easydinner #weeknightdinner #roastchicken #chickenrecipe #cookwithme #easyrecipe #dinneridea

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Pain au Chocolat Recipe 🍫🥐 An Delight of Tender Chocolate and Airy Pastry. The classic elegance of Pain au Chocolat enchants taste buds around the world. This French pastry is an irresistible delicacy, weaving its magic across palates. It's an experience that shouldn't be missed. Makes 8-10 pieces 🥛 Dough: - 180 ml chilled milk - 18 g sugar - 25 g fresh yeast - 35 g cold butter - About 6 g salt - 380 g flour (Type 550) 🍫 Filling: - 160 g cold butter - 16-20 dark chocolate strips 🥚 Brushing: - Egg yolk - 1 tbsp cream/milk 👩🏻‍🍳 Dough Prep: 1. Mix dough ingredients in a kitchen mixer, knead for 5 min. 2. Take needed butter from the fridge for lamination. 3. Roll dough to 21x25 cm. Lamination: 1. Halve 160 g butter lengthwise. 2. Fold dough over butter, wrap, chill 45+ min. 1st Turn: 1. Roll dough to 8-10 mm, fold in thirds, chill 45+ min. 2nd Turn: 1. Treat rolled dough, fold, chill 45+ min. 3rd Turn: 1. Roll, fold, chill 1-2 hours. 🥐 Shaping and Baking: 1. Roll proofed dough to 15x4 mm. 2. Cut 15 cm x 8.5 cm strips. 3. Place halved chocolate bars on dough, roll. 4. Put rolled dough, seams down, on parchment-lined sheet. 5. Proof 2-2.5 hours at room temp. 6. Brush with egg yolk, cream/milk mixture. 7. Preheat oven to 180°C (356°F), bake 20 min. Optional: Brush with maple syrup after baking. Enjoy your homemade Pain au Chocolat! 🥐🍫  #painauchocolat #dessert #cake #dessertrecipe

Stir together cream cheese, sour cream, 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, melted butter, pepperoncini brine, ranch dressing mix, and au jus gravy mix in a large bowl until well combined. Stir in milk. Fold in cooked noodles, chicken, and pepperoncini peppers until evenly coated. Spread mixture into the prepared baking dish; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese. Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Honey bbq chicken sliders ✨🍔 Ingredients  Chicken  - 1lb chicken breast, cut in half to create smaller pieces  - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1 egg - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1/4 cup pickle juice  - 1 1/2 cup all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp salt - 1 tsp black pepper  - 1/2 tsp chicken seasoning  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) - Oil for frying  Dredge mixture  - 1 cup all purpose flour - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp chili powder  - 1 tsp cayenne powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp pepper  - 1/2 tsp chicken seasoning  Honey bbq sauce - 1 tbsp unsalted butter  - 1/3 cup bbq sauce  - 1/4 cup honey - 1 tbsp hot sauce  - 1 tbsp ketchup - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1/2 tsp brown sugar  - 1/8 tsp salt  Instructions: - In a bowl, combine chicken pieces, buttermilk, seasonings, pickle juice and hot sauce. Let sit for 3 hours (or overnight in the fridge for best results). - In another bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. - Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). - Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. - Fry in batches 4–6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, brown sugar, ketchup, hot sauce, garlic powder and bbq sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with honey bbq sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

They always ask why I didn’t make more | full recipe ⬇️ Smoked to perfection with @harmosgrill flavored pellets Serves: 6–8  Total Time: ~2–3 hours (including marinade) Ingredients Chicken 3–4 lbs bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (non-negotiable) 3–4 tbsp spicy brown mustard 2 tbsp Cuso’s Hot Honey Seasoning 2 tbsp Cuso’s Roasted Garlic & Onion Seasoning Grill / Smoke Harmos wood pellets: Spanish Barbecue Pirate & Turkish Barbecue Traveler Jalapeño Green Sauce 2–3 jalapeños (adjust for heat) 1 cup fresh cilantro 2–3 garlic cloves ½ cup Greek yogurt 2–3 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Marinate the Chicken Add chicken thighs to a large bowl. Coat fully with spicy brown mustard. Season generously with Cuso’s Hot Honey + Roasted Garlic & Onion seasoning. Mix until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours (overnight preferred). 2. Preheat the Grill Preheat your pellet grill to 350°F. Load with Harmos pellets (Spanish Barbecue Pirate + Turkish Barbecue Traveler) for deep smoky flavor with paprika, garlic, rosemary, and spice notes. 3. Make the Jalapeño Green Sauce Add jalapeños, cilantro, garlic, Greek yogurt, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning or heat. Chill until ready to serve. 4. Smoke the Chicken Place chicken directly on the grill grates. Cook for about 1 hour, until internal temp reaches 160°F. 5. Crank the Heat Increase grill temp to 500°F. Cook until chicken hits 180°F internal and skin gets crispy with great color. 6. Serve Remove from grill and rest a few minutes. Serve with the jalapeño green sauce on the side or drizzled over top. #HarmosGrill  #HarmosWoodPellets  #HarmosFlavoredPellets

Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender. Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. 🥧HIGH PROTEIN CHICKEN POT PIE🥧 can you believe each serving has 38g of protein? there’s six servings in total and it’s so filling and delicious for a comfy night in.  38g protein / 30g carb / 21g fat / 452 calories per serving Ingredients ⬇️: 2 tbsp butter 1/2 white onion, diced 1 tbsp garlic, minced 1 cup frozen peas 1 cup frozen carrot 2 cup low sodium chicken bone broth  1 tsp thyme 1 tsp sage 1 tsp salt or to taste 1/4 cup all purpose flour 2 cups cottage cheese, blended 2 cups shredded rotisserie chicken 1 sheet of puff pastry Instructions ⬇️: In a large saucepan, melt butter. When butter is melted, add onion and saute until translucent. Add garlic and stir for 1 minute. Add in peas, carrots, and 1 cup of bone broth (save other half for later). Add in thyme, sage, and mix thoroughly.  Slowly add in 1/4 cup of flour and mix until thick like a paste. Add in remainder of bone broth and mix until it looks soupy. Add in blended cottage cheese and chicken and mix.  Taste pot pie filling and add salt as needed. Add filling to a casserole dish (mine is 8x11).  Cut puff pastry into strips and make a basket weave on top of the filling. Mix 1 egg and add egg wash onto puff pastry. Bake according to puff pastry instruction - mine was 20-25minutes at 400 degrees. #chickenpotpie #highproteinrecipes #chickenrecipe #easymealideas #highproteinmeals

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

CRISPY Honey Soy Garlic Chicken BIG M STYLE 🤭 Marinade: • 1½ lbs boneless chicken thighs (skin-on for extra crispiness) • 2 tbsp soy sauce • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • Drizzle of sesame oil • 3 garlic cloves, minced • ¼ tsp white pepper Batter: • ½ cup cornstarch • ¼ tsp white pepper • ¼ tsp onion powder Sauce: • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 1 tbsp neutral oil • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 2½ tbsp soy sauce • 2½ tbsp honey • 1 tbsp brown sugar • ½ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) • Pinch of MSG (optional) Directions: 1. Clean and trim the chicken, then marinate with all marinade ingredients for at least 3 hours. 2. Mix the batter ingredients, coat the chicken evenly, and let it rest for 5 minutes. 3. Fry at 350°F for 8–10 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 4. While the chicken cooks, melt the butter and oil over low heat. Sauté the garlic until fragrant, then stir in the soy sauce, honey, brown sugar, red pepper flakes, and MSG (if using). Simmer until the sauce is glossy. 5. The perennials come back every year (in the UK) and the annuals are easy to grow from seed 🌱 - Alstroemeria - Dahlias - Zinnias (my favourite is ‘Purple Prince’) - Salvia ‘mystic spires’ - Cosmos (my favourites are ‘sensation mix’ and ‘candy stripe’) - Rudbeckia (the longest lasting flowers are ‘Marmalade’) - Erigeron karvinskianus (Mexican fleabane) - Geranium Rozanne  #gardening #flowers #summer

ONE-PAN CREAMY CHICKEN & CHORIZO PASTA  10/10 – this was absolutely f*cking gorgeous  WHAT YOU’LL NEED: • 650g chicken breast, diced • Cooking spray • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp oregano • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 150g chorizo, skin removed and diced • 1 medium brown onion, diced • 30g tomato purée • 250g dried pasta of choice • 800ml chicken stock • Extra paprika, oregano, salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tsp garlic granules • 100ml single cream • Fresh chives, to garnish HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Dice 650g of chicken tits and add them to a large bowl. 2. Spray the chicken with cooking spray, then add 2 tsp of paprika, 1 tsp of oregano, 1 tsp of salt and 1 tsp of black pepper. Mixy mixy motherf**ker! Make sure every piece is completely coated. 3. Add 150g of diced chorizo to a large pan with no oil and cook until beautifully browned and releasing all that glorious chorizo oil. 4. Add the diced brown onion and cook until softened. 5. Chuck in the seasoned chicken tits and 30g of tomato purée, then cook until the chicken is around halfway cooked. 6. Add 250g of dried pasta and pour in 800ml of chicken stock. Give everything a good stir, cover with a lid and simmer for around 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is cooked and the chicken is completely cooked through. 7. Season again with some extra paprika, oregano, a pinch of salt, a pinch of african american pepper and 1 tsp of garlic granules. Garrrrrlic! 8. Pour in 100ml of single cream and mixy mixy motherf**ker! until everything is coated in that ridiculously creamy chorizo sauce. 9. Divide into 5 portions, finish with some freshly chopped chives and enjoy! FULL MACROS: Roughly per portion: 527 calories 45g protein 45g carbohydrates 18g fat 4g fibre DEFINITELY going in the rotation 😂 Cheers, @Panacea Palm

🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Add edible glitter or luster dust for a starry galaxy look. Finish and serve: Let the glaze drip and set for 10–15 minutes. Slice and serve your stunning Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake! Nutritional Information (per slice): ⏰ Prep Time: 1 hour | Baking Time: 30 minutes | Chill Time: 2 hours | Total Time: ~3½ hours 🔥 Kcal: ~520 kcal per slice 🍽️ Servings: 12 This Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake is as mesmerizing as it is delicious — rich chocolate layers filled with creamy ganache and topped with a cosmic swirl of glossy glaze. Perfect for birthdays, celebrations, or anyone who loves desserts that are out of this world! 🌠 #GalaxyCake #MirrorGlaze #ChocolateDessert #CosmicBaking #ShowstopperCake

More than 1,300 people are missing in Nepal and Tibet, including 47 Americans, after a glacial collapse caused catastrophic floods, with video showing mud sweeping through entire communities. Drone footage in Nepal showed roads destroyed and buildings buried by thundering water the color of wet cement. Nepalese authorities ramped up operations in the worst-affected districts of Nuwakot and Rasuwa. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet is not a one-off. The Lhende Khola river system has now flooded twice in just 14 months and the increasingly unstable Himalayan ice system threatens communities, infrastructure and water supplies across one of the world’s most densely populated regions. The region saw similar flash floods in August last year, when a glacial lake in Tibet overflowed because of high temperatures. Nine people were killed, and critical infrastructure, including a bridge connecting Nepal and China, was damaged.

Recipe Name Smash Burger Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb ground beef 2. 6 small flour tortillas 3. 6 slices cheddar cheese 4. 2 cups shredded lettuce 5. 1/2 cup diced onion 6. 1/2 cup diced tomatoes 7. 1 tbsp olive oil 8. 1 tsp salt 9. 1/2 tsp black pepper 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1 tsp smoked paprika 12. 1/2 cup mayonnaise 13. 2 tbsp ketchup 14. 1 tbsp yellow mustard 15. 1 tbsp finely chopped pickles 16. 1 tsp pickle juice 17. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 18. 1/4 tsp black pepper Recipe 1. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, chopped pickles, pickle juice, garlic powder, and black pepper. 2. Stir the sauce until smooth, then refrigerate while preparing the tacos. 3. Divide the ground beef into 6 equal portions. 4. Season the beef lightly with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 5. Place one tortilla on a hot skillet or griddle. 6. Press one portion of ground beef directly onto the tortilla, spreading it into a thin, even layer almost to the edges. 7. Cook beef-side down for 2–3 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. 8. Flip the tortilla and beef together, then immediately place a slice of cheddar cheese on top. 9. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted. 10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and beef. 11. Top each taco with shredded lettuce, diced onion, and diced tomatoes. 12. Drizzle generously with the creamy burger sauce. 13. Fold the tacos slightly and serve immediately while the beef is hot and the cheese is melted. 14. Add extra pickles or sauce if desired for an even more classic burger flavor. Sear shrimp in a skillet over medium-high heat (2–3 mins per side). Add butter, baste, then remove and set aside. 4. In the same skillet, sauté garlic, spinach, and sun-dried tomatoes. 5. Add heavy cream + pasta water. Stir in all sauce seasonings + Parmesan. Simmer on low-medium. 6. Fold in crab meat (save some for topping) and let simmer again. 7. How to build an AI employee that works while you sleep. An AI agent is just a loop (goal → step → check → repeat) that can reach for tools. On its own it hits a wall: it forgets everything, waits for you, owns nothing. The ladder that turns it into staff: • ① context — files YOU write; it reads them every run so nothing's generic, and they grow (you're raising it) • ② memory — facts + your rules + how-to's; a skill is a memory • ③ a lane, not a task • ④ tools — MCP, ~1 min to connect • ⑤ a schedule — wakes on its own, pings you only for decisions • ⑥ guardrails — low-stakes it does; high-stakes it drafts and waits for your yes I run mine from a Google Sheet — it drafts every reply in my voice, I approve in 10 minutes, every 30 minutes it sends the approved ones and learns from my revisions. The moat: anyone can buy the same AI. Nobody has your context. Come build it with me. #aiemployee #aiagent #aiautomation #professorglitch

Crispy Beef Street Corn Tacos 🌽🔥 Ingredients: For the Tacos: -1 lb ground beef -1 packet taco seasoning -2–3 tbsp salsa -1–2 tsp chipotle adobo sauce (adjust to spice preference) -Small flour tortillas -Shredded cheese For the Street Corn Topping: -1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese -Splash of water (for blending) -1 to 1 1/2 tbsp light mayo -1 cup corn -1–2 jalapeños, finely diced -Chopped pickled red onion -2–3 tbsp cotija cheese -Fresh cilantro, chopped -Everything But The Elote seasoning -Juice of 1 lime For Finishing: -Hot honey -Lime wedges Instructions: 1. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the corn and cook until charred. Remove from heat and let cool. 2. For the Street Corn Mixture: Add cottage cheese and a splash of water to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a bowl and mix in: -charred corn -mayo -diced jalapeños -pickled red onion -cotija -cilantro -lime juice -elote seasoning to taste Set aside. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease if needed. Stir in taco seasoning, salsa, and chipotle adobo sauce. Cook for another 2–3 minutes until it’s all absorbed.  4. Place flour tortillas on a baking sheet (spray with oil if needed). Add a layer of shredded cheese, spoon in taco meat, then top with more cheese. Fold each tortilla in half. Place a baking rack on top of the tacos to help keep them closed while baking. Spray with avocado oil.  5. Bake at 425°F for 10–15 minutes, or until golden, crispy, and the cheese is melted. 6. Top warm tacos with the street corn mixture. Finish with a drizzle of hot honey and squeeze of lime. SO GOOD 😮‍💨😮‍💨 #fyp #explorepage✨ #easyrecipe #dinner #healthy

Honey Mustard: Mayo, Dijon, yellow mustard, honey, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder & salt. Mix until smooth. Chili Honey Glaze: Warm honey, butter, red pepper flakes, chili crisp oil, apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika & salt over low heat until combined, then dunk or brush the fried chicken with the glaze. Make the Slaw & Build: Toss together green cabbage, red cabbage, kale, carrots, mayo, Dijon, honey, apple cider vinegar, lemon juice, salt & pepper. Toast buttered brioche buns, then build with pickles → chili honey fried chicken → slaw → and honey mustard.
